verdict.rationale: llama.cpp runs as command-line binaries: `llama cli` for terminal inference and `llama serve` for a server, plus Docker images and pre-built binaries. None of these needs a GUI, which suits servers and containerized pipelines, and the built-in web UI is an optional front-end to the server rather than a requirement. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of headless or CI-pipeline usage in the evidence, and no independent hands-on corroboration of server or CI deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines

citations.quote: Run with Docker - see our [Docker documentation](docs/docker.md)
